metadata.description: A notice from Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology warning prospective BE/BTech students and their parents about fraudulent admission claims and emphasizing merit-based admissions without management quotas.

result.title: For Kind Attention: Prospective students seeking admission in BE/BTech and their Parents
result.summary: The partial document is a notice from Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology (TIET) addressing prospective BE/BTech students and their parents. It emphasizes that admissions are strictly based on merit according to the eligibility criteria and warns against fraudulent agents claiming to secure admissions through donations or management quotas. TIET clarifies that no agents are appointed for student enrollment, there is no management quota, and all fees must be paid directly to the institute's account. The document advises reporting any suspicious offers and states that TIET is not liable for losses from fraudulent transactions.
result.text:
For Kind Attention: Prospective students seeking admission in BE/BTech and their Parents  
  
  
General public is hereby informed that all the admissions in BE/BTech program are made 
on the merit as prescribed in the eligibility criteria. The entire admission process and latest 
notices related to admissions/counselling are available on our 
website(ww w.thapar.edu). It has been reported that certain unscrupulous 
individuals/entities/agents are approaching prospective students and their parents 
claiming that they can arrange admission of their ward at TIET by paying donation money 
or getting them admitte d under management quota or by getting their ward nominated 
by the Government etc. These agents are demanding hefty amount of money for getting 
the needful done. For safeguard of prospective students and parents, TIET clarifies as 
under:  
1. TIET has never appointed any agents/entities for student enrollment in BE/BTech 
program.  
2. All admissions shall be made on the merit prepared on the basis of prescribed 
eligibility.  
3. There is no Management quota at TIET.  
4. The candidates selected for admission are required to pay the fee as prescribed 
on our website https://thapar.edu/ . There are no other charges/fee over and 
above the prescribed fee.  
5. The fee has to be deposited by the selected candidates in the account number 
of TIET directly. No individual has been authorized to collect the fee in cash.   
 If you receive any suspicious offers or requests from any individual/agency, please 
email us at registrar@thapar.edu.   
Important Note: TIET, Patiala shall not bear any responsibility or liability whatsoever for any 
loss suffered by any person for any such fraudulent transaction committed on their own.   
  
Prof Padmakumar Nair   
Vice -Chancellor
